## Constraints

### Must

- Use the gold Tree of Life icon on Aeiva mist in the header.
- Use `assets/aeiva-favicon.png` as the only favicon source.
- Keep the waitlist form disconnected until its destination is supplied.
- Preserve reduced-motion support and native sequential video playback on touch and desktop.
- Collect only low-sensitivity product-research data: wearable, up to two focus areas, launch market, email, and optional name and beta interest.
- Treat iPhone and iOS Safari as the primary mobile target, including safe-area insets, 44px-plus touch targets, native `playsInline` video, and no hover-dependent controls.
- Present the Amsterdam address exactly as `Science Park 608, 1098 XH Amsterdam, Netherlands` and show the Netherlands-first, India-second launch order.
- Keep third-party logos in their approved colors and proportions with accurate role labels.

### Avoid

- Do not claim preview submissions are stored.
- Do not connect to the existing Baxter Labs waitlist endpoint.
- Do not collect medical history, diagnoses, body measurements, date of birth, gender, or document uploads in the waitlist funnel.
- Do not present a fabricated health score, eligibility result, queue position, scarcity claim, or referral reward.
- Do not describe grant and program backers as equity investors or formal corporate partners unless that separate relationship is verified.

## Decisions

- Use a conversion-focused, light editorial Aeiva direction with the supplied lockup, navy-and-gold hierarchy, mist background, direct early-access copy, and a three-stage journey: promise-led hero, progressive Clarity Profile, and personalised value-and-expectations page.
- Keep the Clarity Profile visibly in preview mode with native validation and no persistence or network activity.
- Use the original remote 4K humanoid source with no watermark overlay. Play it natively in sequence on every device and use one `requestAnimationFrame` loop for desktop-only 3D cursor following with `translate3d`, `rotateX`, `rotateY`, `scale3d`, and a separate lightweight aura. Never seek the single-keyframe source.
- Keep iPhone playback native and transform-static, use `100svh` with a fallback, respect safe-area insets, and place the credibility rail after the media rather than overlaying it on short or touch viewports.
- The user confirmed official grants and support from Demonstrator Lab, Startup Village, Google for Startups, Cloudflare, Attio, and Wispr Flow. Present their self-hosted official marks as one “Backed by” group, qualified as “Grants, programs & infrastructure supporting Aeiva,” and preserve provenance in `assets/partner-logos/SOURCES.md`.
- Capture UTM and referral context only inside first-party in-page analytics hooks; do not install a tracker or send data until consent and a destination are supplied.
- Present the launch markets consistently as Amsterdam first, followed by Chennai.
- Use the quiet premium message spine: “Your health, made clear”; one clear action for today; personal, independent, and built for better decisions.
- Reuse the off-white social-profile logo treatment in the website header while leaving the user-selected favicon unchanged.
